1:35.text: And the angel said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore the child to be born will be called holy, the Son of God.
1:35.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

23:42.text: And he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come in your kingly power."
23:42.notes: RSVCE (1966) reading. Patrick's own printing reads "into your kingdom" (the 1971 RSV wording) and the book follows his printing.

15:17.text: But when he came to himself he said, 'How many of my father's hired servants have bread enough and to spare, but I perish here with hunger!

15:20.text: And he arose and came to his father. But while he was yet at a distance, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and embraced him and kissed him.

15:24.text: for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found.' And they began to make merry.

23:43.text: And he said to him, "Truly, I say to you, today you will be with me in Paradise."
23:43.notes: RSVCE and RSV agree on v.43. v.42 differs (RSVCE 'in your kingly power'; Patrick's printing 'into your kingdom'); Ch. 11 cites 23:42-43 without quoting.
